scope: Local farm art only; no DB/catalog updates or remote upload

items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE transparent PNG game tile for the cozy Pongdang Island farm. Reference 1 is STYLE ONLY warm friendly cartoon cel shading and soft thin brown outlines; do not copy the otter. Reference 2 is STYLE and rustic palette ONLY, not building anatomy. Subject: one empty cultivated soil plot, an almost square orthogonal footprint seen from a gently elevated front/top view, NOT an isometric diamond. Softly rounded earth corners, warm medium cocoa soil, three broad shallow horizontal planting furrows, a few tiny natural soil crumbs, very subtle front earth thickness. Clean minimal hand-painted cartoon rendering matching the reference farm, readable at 40 pixels. It must look like cultivated EARTH, not a wooden tray, planter box, bread, planks or sand. No wooden border, stone border, grass border, plant, seed, tool, text, symbols, UI, heavy outline, ground plane or cast shadow. Entire isolated square earth tile centered, approximately 80% canvas width and 72% height, even transparent padding. True alpha transparency; no checkerboard, black background or white matte.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve the EXACT soil tile, camera, outline, furrows, position, scale and warm cartoon colors in the reference. Change ONLY its central planting hole: show exactly ONE LARGE pale warm-cream seed, about a quarter of the earth tile width, nestled diagonally in the center and half-covered by a small mound of dark moist cocoa soil. The bright seed must be clearly visible at 40px, visibly different from an empty dark hole. A little damp darker earth around the seed shows freshly planted status. ONE seed and ONE planting site only. No sprout, leaves, other holes, rows, UI, symbols, text, extra objects, backdrop or matte. Actual alpha-transparent background, matching original canvas and tile footprint. Friendly clean farm cartoon rendering.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve the exact soil tile and the SINGLE existing tall green stem and two leaves. Move ONLY the whole green plant and its small root mound about 60 pixels DOWN on this 1280px canvas so its entire visual silhouette is centered vertically on the soil. Do not move or resize the soil. Keep one large slender stem, two broad young leaves and one tiny top bud, no extra plants. Clean warm farm cartoon, preserve true alpha transparency and all original framing. CRITICAL CENTERING: the visual bounding-box center of the WHOLE plant (from its top leaf or grain to the root base, including side leaves) must coincide with the soil tile's visual center BOTH horizontally AND vertically, around 51% of canvas width and 46% of canvas height. Do not center only the roots. The plant's root base sits below the center and its tip sits equally far above the center. Preserve the exact soil tile footprint and its position.

normalization.method: Normalize generated canvases to 512; use one shared union of visible alpha >=32 with 2px margin; fill 504x504 and add 4px transparent padding. Intentional common vertical fit makes the earth occupy a square game cell. Same crop/fit for all stages; no separate per-stage scaling. Originals preserved.
